disclaimer: Simplified estimate for national income tax only. Local income tax (10% of national tax), employment income deduction, personal deductions, tax credits, and social insurance contributions are not included.

regimes.label: National Income Tax (2024) (Resident)
regimes.notes: National income tax only. Local income tax (10% of computed national tax) is separate and not included.

regimes.label: Non-Resident / Expatriate Flat Tax
regimes.notes: Foreign employees may elect a flat 19% tax on gross employment income as an alternative to progressive rates, in lieu of standard deductions and credits — a well-known expatriate election, not a mandatory non-resident rate.

residency_threshold_note: ADVISORY ONLY, not a legal determination: 183+ days physically present in a tax year is commonly used as a resident-status guideline. Actual rules vary by country (tie-breaker tests, visa type, permanent home, center of vital interests, etc.) and this figure does not override your own judgment or professional advice.
